notes: All 8 WebSearches used (cap reached). 50 WebFetch calls used. Year and venue judgment calls: (1) The Riftbound North American Regional page writes its dates without a year; the article is dated July 2026 and says this December, so December 11 to 13, 2026 is recorded at medium confidence. Venue is Convergence Fest in Las Vegas with no hall named. (2) MagicCon Atlanta: the official site publishes no venue name and dealer table prices; the page heading says 2025 once while the event dates say 2026; prices carry a dollar sign only and are recorded as USD from the US venue. Third-party sites mention a dealer hall, which is not verified. (3) CoolStuffCon Orlando: dates and free admission come from the organizer's site banner. The venue and vendor pricing were not found. A Spooky Empire exhibitor form for Orlando was seen in search results but is a different show and was not used. (4) SWU Minneapolis (Jan 9 and 10, 2027) and SCG CON Minneapolis (Jan 8 to 10, 2027) both name the Minneapolis Convention Center on overlapping dates; not confirmed whether they are linked. (5) Riot calls the Dallas event a Continental, not a Regional. Not recorded, with reasons: past events with no size data (BCG Fest Dallas Sept 18 to 20, 2026; Lorcana North American Championship Anaheim Aug 28 to 30, 2026; Digimon Gen Con July 30, 2026, Toronto Sept 6, 2026, Milwaukee Oct 3, 2026; SWU Ashes of the Empire sector qualifiers in Indianapolis and Fort Worth, Aug and Sept 2026); Star Wars Unlimited Planetary Qualifiers, which are store events outside this brief (dozens across August 2026 to January 2027); Sorcery local store events on the sorcerytcg.com event list (store events, not premier); Riftbound Madrid and Oceania regionals (not North America). Gaps with no North American record found on allowed pages: 2027 North American MagicCon dates, Flesh and Blood 2027 Callings, Sorcery premier events for 2026 to 2027, Gundam Season 2 North American venues, One Piece Season 2 North American regional venues, Disney Lorcana official 2026 to 2027 North American dates, and the Dragon Ball Fusion World North American finals venue. Digimon North American Area Finals are invite only with one listing dated October 16, 2026 and no region. Treasure Cup December events list an advance registration guideline of September 27, 2026. SCG CON pages contain no vendor booth prices for any event. No phone numbers or personal addresses recorded. Today is 2026-10-21 and SCG CON Hartford starts October 23, 2026.
